'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''

**[[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine]]

'''International relations'''
*The [[United Nations]] formally recognizes the new official name of ''Türkiye'' following an official request from [[Turkey]] to change its name. Turkish state broadcaster [[Turkish Radio and Television Corporation|TRT]] says that the name change is primarily to avoid association with the [[Turkey (bird)|bird of the same name]].
